M01.label: MEANINGFUL
M01.reason: For a missing attribute the filter returns None instead of an Undefined, so {{ x|attr('missing') }} renders 'None' instead of '' and StrictUndefined / 'is defined' semantics are lost.

M02.label: MEANINGFUL
M02.reason: With an empty cmd_parts the generator returns without ever yielding, so entering the pager context raises RuntimeError: generator didn't yield instead of falling back to stdout via _nullpager (reachable at least by calling the helper with an empty command list).

M03.label: MEANINGFUL
M03.reason: After an ANSI sequence the next character is counted and skipped without checking for another escape, so back-to-back escapes (e.g. click.style with fg and bold) are cut mid-sequence (n=3 returns 'ESC[31mESC[1') and a trailing escape is now included.

M04.label: MEANINGFUL
M04.reason: For an unset boolean flag with a callback, control falls through to Parameter.process_value, which type-casts the callback's result and invokes the callback a second time (double side effects, or BadParameter/crash when the callback returns a non-boolean).

M05.label: MEANINGFUL
M05.reason: The version option now defaults to expose_value=True, so running the command without --version passes an unexpected 'version' keyword to the command function (TypeError).

M06.label: MEANINGFUL
M06.reason: A missing attribute now falls through to environment.getattr, which falls back to obj[name], so {'a': 1}|attr('a') returns 1 instead of Undefined, defeating the filter's documented no-item-lookup behaviour.

M07.label: MEANINGFUL
M07.reason: On the empty-cmd_parts fallback the _nullpager block no longer yields, so the generator finishes without yielding and the pager context manager raises RuntimeError instead of writing to stdout.

M08.label: MEANINGFUL
M08.reason: After printing the version the program no longer exits, so the command body still runs (or a group fails with 'Missing command') after --version.

M09.label: MEANINGFUL
M09.reason: With capture='fd', bytes written directly to file descriptor 1 (subprocesses, C extensions, os.write) are silently dropped from result.stdout and result.output.

M10.label: MEANINGFUL
M10.reason: The inverted check returns Undefined for attributes that do exist dynamically via __getattr__ and lets genuinely missing ones fall through to the obj[name] item fallback.

M11.label: MEANINGFUL
M11.reason: The version option is no longer eager by default, so '--version --help' prints help and an invalid earlier option ('--n abc --version') errors instead of printing the version.

M12.label: MEANINGFUL
M12.reason: In the max_lines placeholder loop the last chunk is never removed, so TextWrapper(width=10, max_lines=1) turns 'hello world' into the over-width 'hello [...]' instead of '[...]', and with drop_whitespace=False a trailing whitespace chunk loops forever.

M13.label: MEANINGFUL
M13.reason: Removing the whole with-block leaves the empty-cmd_parts path returning without a yield, so the pager context manager raises RuntimeError instead of falling back to stdout.

M14.label: MEANINGFUL
M14.reason: Deferred annotations keep the import working, but the public alias click.testing.CaptureMode vanishes: 'from click.testing import CaptureMode' raises ImportError and typing.get_type_hints on CliRunner raises NameError.

M15.label: TRIVIAL
M15.reason: Only the AssertionError message text changes, on the misuse path of calling stop() without start().

M16.label: TRIVIAL
M16.reason: After stop() saved_fd keeps the stale, already-closed descriptor number instead of -1, and nothing shown reads it afterwards.

M17.label: MEANINGFUL
M17.reason: The empty-cmd_parts fallback enters and exits _nullpager without yielding, so the generator never yields and the pager context manager raises RuntimeError instead of writing to stdout.

M18.label: MEANINGFUL
M18.reason: With capture='fd' stderr capture is never started, so cap_err.stop() in the finally block trips its 'start() was not called' assertion and every invoke crashes.

M19.label: TRIVIAL
M19.reason: Only the stack frame the DeprecationWarning is attributed to changes (one frame above the caller's with statement).

M20.label: MEANINGFUL
M20.reason: On the unset-boolean-flag path the condition is inverted: with no callback it calls None (TypeError), and with a callback it skips the callback entirely.

M21.label: MEANINGFUL
M21.reason: Dropping the hasattr check makes every statically missing attribute fall through to environment.getattr's obj[name] fallback, so dict keys are returned instead of Undefined.

M22.label: MEANINGFUL
M22.reason: Without the early return, the callback (which click runs even when --version is absent, and during shell completion) always prints the version and exits.

M23.label: MEANINGFUL
M23.reason: The try block can no longer raise, so the filter always goes through environment.getattr and falls back to obj[name] for missing attributes.

M24.label: TRIVIAL
M24.reason: Signer.unsign applies want_bytes itself, so every built-in signer gives identical results; only a custom signer that inspects or rejects str input could tell the difference.

M25.label: MEANINGFUL
M25.reason: With max_lines >= 2 truncation happens one line early, e.g. TextWrapper(width=10, max_lines=2) on 'aaa bbb ccc ddd eee fff' gives ['aaa [...]'] instead of ['aaa bbb', 'ccc [...]'].

M26.label: TRIVIAL
M26.reason: iter_unsigners always yields at least one signer, so last_exception is bound before the raise; only a subclass yielding no signers sees UnboundLocalError instead of TypeError.

M27.label: EQUIVALENT
M27.reason: Tuple comparison against (3, 11) never inspects a third element: (a, b, c) >= (3, 11) holds exactly when (a, b) >= (3, 11), because on a tie of the first two the longer tuple compares greater.
